  • Method Details

    • all

      List<Drawable> all()
      Returns every drawable in the model, in host order.

    • previewSourceTriangulation

      default ArtMeshSourceTriangulation previewSourceTriangulation(ArtMeshGeometry geometry)
      Runs the native source-plane triangulator on detached input. Does not create a drawable, bind parameters, change selection or add history. The result may merge points or change faces; callers must compare it with their source before using it to plan editable partitions. Availability is host-version specific.

    • select

      default void select(List<ArtMeshId> ids)
      Replaces the Editor's transient ArtMesh selection. Does not edit model data or history.

    • create

      default Drawable create(String name, Part parent, int index, ArtMeshGeometry geometry)

    • createWithSourceGeometry

      default Drawable createWithSourceGeometry(String name, Part parent, int index, ArtMeshGeometry sourceGeometry, List<Point2> defaultPositions)
      Creates an ArtMesh with separate texture-source and default-form coordinates. Source positions are used by the Editor to reconstruct UVs; default positions are the initial visible shape. Both lists use the same vertex order and count. The caller must supply source geometry consistent with the intended image mapping. This operation does not register an image or change an existing mesh. Creation, including both coordinate domains, is one native Undo operation.
      Throws:
      UnsupportedOperationException - when separate source coordinates are unavailable

    • createManyWithSourceGeometry

      default List<Drawable> createManyWithSourceGeometry(List<Drawables.SourceGeometryRequest> requests)
      Appends ArtMeshes in input order, preserving separate source/default coordinates. Creates one authoring edit and publishes model instances once for the complete batch. Parent Parts must already exist. No target deformer or image is assigned, so callers can bind images before performing native parent-coordinate conversion. Returns handles in request order; unsupported backends fail without falling back to repeated single-object publication. An empty batch creates no edit.

    • remove

      default void remove(Drawable drawable)
      Deletes drawable through the native selection + native DELETE command path.
